content:
alyssa: Heads up — working through private-offer structure for the GCP marketplace pilot. Need alignment on SKU thresholds, onramp credits, SI handoff, and joint announcement timing. cc @mike_sales @sarah_product :eyes:

mike_sales: Quick q — what's our target commit size for pilots? are we doing upfront credits or milestone/usage credits?

sarah_product: Prefer milestone credits to avoid heavy rev deferral. Suggest: onboarding bump (first 3 months), then step-down. Keeps ops simple for the SI.

javier_finance: High level we can model 3 bands: pilot (<=50k) -> 25% onboarding credit, growth (50-250k) -> 15% spread over 12mo, enterprise (>250k) -> negotiated. Need to run the ARR/deferral impact.

alyssa: That 3-band sounds doable. Field is asking for a simple table and a one-pager for SIs that explains qualifying usage and how credits apply. Who owns which piece?

sarah_product: Product can draft the messaging matrix and the FAQ for technical questions. I'll include a short example flow for qualifying customers.

alyssa: Partnerships will own SI comms + templated private offer payloads for the marketplace team. mike — will your AMs be comfortable with a 3-band model?

mike_sales: Yes but AMs want a clear playbook: eligibility, how to qualify, and what escalations look like. Also, can we give a short script for negotiations?

javier_finance: I'll produce the P&L with revenue deferral scenarios by Friday. Need the final percentage numbers and durations.

lina-bot: Creating tracker: https://app.redwood/tracker/marketplace-gcp-pilot — added initial tasks (sarah: messaging draft, javier: P&L, mike: field deck).

alyssa: Putting a sample config below so the marketplace team can prototype the private offer UI:```
private_offer:
  sku: "redwood-gcp-pro"
  tiers:
    - threshold: 50000
      credit_pct: 25
      duration_months: 3
    - threshold: 250000
      credit_pct: 15
      duration_months: 12
    - threshold: 250001
      credit_pct: "custom"
      duration_months: 12
```

sarah_product: Nice. For the one-pager let's include: sample customer story, SI benefits, how credits are applied in billing, and renewal nudges at month 9.

mike_sales: Also propose a short incentive for SI to bring customers past the pilot threshold (one-off referral credit applied after usage validation). keeps SI motivated to push for scale.

javier_finance: Referral credit is OK if we cap it and expense it as partner costs. I'll add a modelling column.

announce-bot: Draft joint announcement & blog timeline: initial draft due 2026-04-05, legal review by 2026-04-08, joint publish target 2026-04-15.

alyssa: Action items recap: sarah -> messaging + one-pager (due Wed), javier -> P&L & deferral scenarios (due Fri), mike -> field deck + SI script (due Thu), partnerships -> SI handoff kit + marketplace payloads (I'll own). Lina-bot will track.

mike_sales: +1

sarah_product: +1

javier_finance: 👍 I'll ping if I need alternate %s.

alyssa: Thanks all — keeping this thread as single source for updates. I'll post the first draft of the SI one-pager later today.
